_: bengali-ids.json — the number in each Bengali note's id, pinned to its note: <deck id> → <headword> (an alphabet row's key) → N, for the id u_<deck id>_N. A note of these decks is one note with two card templates, so both of a word's cards hang off this number (the second card is <id>~2). Seeded on 2026-11-19 from the seven decks as shipped at commit 2b3cf5c, every one of them numbered by position until then, and APPLIED by bengali-fix.js and build-bengali-alphabet.js: a rebuilt deck, which the generator numbers by position, is numbered back. NEVER delete or renumber a row — the Update press merges a reader's progress by id. A note a deck loses moves to _retired; a new note takes the next free number; a rename renames the key.
